title: S2-B3 outcome-blind conditioning feasibility audit
decision: Authorize an outcome-blind feasibility audit before freezing SW10-S2-B3 conditioning-state thresholds. Compute factor values and eligibility/cross-sectional state membership only, quantify interaction cell sizes and coverage for candidate conditioning schemes, and recommend a statistically feasible scheme without reading or computing forward-return outcomes.
evidence: MWE-SW10-S2B2-001 COMPLETE/VERIFIED; B2 primary family had no BH-FDR survivors. Existing certified 112-symbol, 394-date panel and frozen causal factor implementations provide sufficient inputs for an outcome-blind membership audit.
rationale: B2 completed with no factor advanced. B3 is proposed to test factor roles and conditional structure, but exact conditioning thresholds must be selected prospectively. Coverage-only feasibility evidence can resolve this without outcome-driven threshold selection.
